findings.summary: `initialState` is assigned the Flow itself, not its first emitted value, so the null-check never triggers onboarding.
findings.mechanism: `programStateRepo.observe(program.id)` returns `Flow<ProgramState?>`; without calling `.first()` on it, `initialState` holds a non-null Flow object. `if (initialState == null)` is therefore always false, so `startDestination` is always `TopLevelRoute.Main` — onboarding can never be shown, even on first launch with no program state. The `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first` import was added but never used, confirming the intended `.first()` call was dropped.
